text: Run 1 (host-independence) done under the chain, every node on its first attempt: the installer test builds its PATH from resolved binaries (binariesInPath), the host-layout guard scans test/ for machine-layout assumptions and the 21 env-node fixture shebangs were converted to process.execPath, and root-pointers.test proves the four pointers stay symlinks. Full suite green on each integrated candidate with the guard active; promoted, contract 2 launched by the coordinator. USD 3.41.

generated-command-manual attempt 1 tripped two sharedVerification ratchets (OPERATION_OPTIONS exported by four modules; manual.mjs without a header) and attempt 2 fixed both then blocked with context_missing: test/host/ci-policy.test.mjs pins the ci.yml run steps and was not in the packet (orchestrator omission). Resolved by resume --answer instead of a follow-up contract: the ci.yml step is withdrawn and the requirement 'CI fails when the manual drifts' is met by the byte-identical render test in test/cli/manual.test.mjs, which npm test already runs in CI. First real use of the base-ref resume fix: resume ran from HEAD on main without detaching.

Run 2 (generated-manual) done on attempt 3: docs/COMMANDS.md is regenerated by src/cli/manual.mjs from the CLI's own option tables (default-exported per verb module) with authored prose preserved, npm run docs / docs:check added, drift fails npm test through the byte-identical render test; attempt 1 tripped two sharedVerification ratchets, attempt 2 blocked on the ci-policy test outside scope and was answered by withdrawing the ci.yml step. Judge passed; promoted; contract 3 launched by the coordinator. USD 4.42.

Run 3 (reference-load): reference-load-guard done on the first attempt and promoted by hand (workerReferenceSet, docs/ refusal with the write-scope exception); declared-read-bytes blocked with context_missing because the packet omitted the node-snapshot validator allowlist (src/contract/snapshot.mjs) and the NodeSnapshot typedef -- the same authoring error as the base-ref node one campaign earlier, now recorded as a standing rule. Superseded by contract 3b-declared-read-bytes with the complete write set; manifest is 1, 2, 3b.

Run 3b (declared-read-bytes): declared-read-bytes-recorded done on the first attempt with the complete write set (snapshot validator allowlist, NodeSnapshot typedef, dispatch, render, final report, tests); judge passed; integrated candidate verified with the full suite; promoted by the coordinator, which reported the campaign done. USD 4.80.

Campaign env-independence-and-generated-docs, 2026-09-17 00:22 UTC to about 03:00 UTC (2.6 h): the second campaign of the improvement loop and the first authored from an owner-written proposal (PROPOSAL.md, with the orchestrator's fact-check addendum), Anthropic models only (claude-sonnet-5 workers USD 11.11, claude-opus-5 judge USD 3.00, USD 14.11 in all), driven by supervise campaign from the installed 0.6.0 CLI in four runs (1, 2, 3, 3b) over 7 node instances, 9 attempts and 15 provider invocations. Landed on main by a --no-ff merge (5857b44, the feat commit) with the full suite green. Delivered, each node's integrated candidate verified with the whole suite: the installer test builds its PATH from resolved binaries (binariesInPath) and never names where node lives; a host-layout guard (hostLayoutFindings) refuses PATH built from system directories, version-manager references and process.platform in assertions, and env-node fixture shebangs -- the 21 existing fixtures now run node directly, closing the class that produced two campaigns of load flakes; test/repo/root-pointers proves the four pointers stay symlinks; docs/COMMANDS.md is regenerated by src/cli/manual.mjs from the CLI's own option tables with the authored prose preserved (renderManual), npm run docs and docs:check, drift fails npm test; the worker-loadable reference set is declared (workerReferenceSet) and readFiles under docs/ is refused unless the node writes the file; declaredReadBytes is recorded on the node snapshot at dispatch and exposed by status and report.
